'''2018 MPC Day 2 Phil Aasen LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phil Aasen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
